messages:
Maya L.: kicking preflight for v1.9.2 rollout — plan: US -> EU -> APAC. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. need quick capacity + pin sanity checks :eyes:
Josef: linked release notes and changelog: https://internal/release/v1.9.2 - looks fine, lgtm on the schema changes. :thumbsup:
Ron: capacity snapshot: US reserved pool 120k rps, warm pool ~18 GPUs. recommend start us-alpha at 10% traffic (12k rps equivalent), us-beta 25% later. EU has a scheduled db compaction at 03:10 UTC, so EU can't run full canary until db window cleared.
Priya K.: suggest EU canary start at 5% with KV cache warmup for 30m. fallback pin policy -> auto-pin to v1.9.1 on >1% 5xx or error-rate delta >0.8%.
DeployBot: [deploy-scheduler] Deploy queued by Maya L. -> release:v1.9.2; rollout: regional phased; regions=[us,e u,apac]; slices=[alpha,beta]; initial-slices=us-alpha(10%)
ops-runner: smoke check script output (first 6m):
```
us-alpha: 200 OK 98.6%
us-alpha: 400/500 combined 1.4% (mostly 400s)
median latency + p95 within baseline
```
Lucy M.: seeing a small uptick in sampler timeout traces in us-alpha, correlates with 400s. digging into logs now.
Ron: if 400s are client payload errors vs service errors we'll tolerate a bit, but if we see increase in 5xx we need immediate rollback. set EU holdpoint until we get stable US metrics.
Priya K.: can we quarantine EU traffic to staging route for now? i.e. route EU canary requests through feature-flagged path so we don't impact production users.
Maya L.: agree. action items: 1) hold EU at 0% external traffic, 2) continue US-alpha at 10% for warmup, 3) monitor for 5xx >0.8% threshold.
DeployBot: [deploy] us-alpha v1.9.2 -> active at 10% (ts=2134102180)
ops-runner: metric alert: us-alpha 400s drifted to 2.1% at 2134102305, sampler timeouts trending up, p95 latency +60ms.
Lucy M.: root cause hypothesis: sampler change in v1.9.2 introduces stricter validation leading to input rejection (400). tests show payload normalization mismatch. rolling patch may be needed.
Josef: given this, recommend immediate traffic quarantine and pin to v1.9.1 for any region showing >1.5% client errors to avoid bad UX.
Maya L.: ok decision call — rollback us-alpha to v1.9.1 and abort EU canary. APAC stay blocked. tagging SRE for postmortem.
DeployBot: [rollback] us-alpha -> v1.9.1 initiated by Maya L. (ts=2134102410) TTL: immediate
ops-runner: rollback completed, us-alpha now serving v1.9.1 (ts=2134102455). errors back down to 0.3% in 2m.
Lucy M.: confirming logs show validation layer restored to previous behavior. will open PR for sampler normalization fix and add a unit test + integration check.
Priya K.: notes for next deploy: add an opt-in feature-flag for sampler validation, and a preflight synthetic test that sends malformed-ish payloads.
Maya L.: next steps: hold APAC, cancel EU rollout. schedule patch release v1.9.2.1 after PR and CI. create incident ticket INC-3421 and assign to Lucy + Ron for follow-up. I'll update release notes and changelog with rollback reasons.
Josef: I'll update the deployment playbook with this new canary step (payload-negative tests).
DeployBot: [note] Deployment aborted for regions [eu,apac]. All slices pinned back to v1.9.1 where applicable.
Maya L.: thanks team — quick triage saved the rollout. we'll reconvene 10:30 UTC for postmortem sync. :coffee:
